channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Fire kills 16 students at Kenyan girls’ boarding school
item.description: At least 16 students were killed and dozens injured after a fire tore through the dormitory of a girls’ school in Kenya.

item.title: WHO chief heads to ‘hardest hit’ Ituri as DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak spreads
item.description: DRC battles Bundibugyo strain as confirmed cases rise to 121, with 17 deaths and 246 suspected fatalities reported.

item.title: US attacks Bandar Abbas again: Why is the port so important for Iran?
item.description: Bandar Abbas, which the US has targeted multiple times, occupies a strategically sensitive position in Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Why has Trump threatened to bomb Oman, amid Iran war escalation?
item.description: The US president has issued a stark warning to a US ally, in a sign of rising tensions over Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran says US must issue multiple-entry visas for its World Cup squad
item.description: Iran's delegation will be based in Tijuana, Mexico, and will travel to the US for all three group stage matches.

item.title: For Gaza, Eid joy is now a form of resistance
item.description: Six were killed in Remal on Eid night. Minutes later, the stalls reopened.

item.title: Gaza City hospitals say several killed in strike, as Israel targets Hamas leaders
item.description: At least five children were reportedly killed in the strike, which appears to have targeted a Hamas commander.

item.title: Are US and Iran close to peace or sliding back to war?
item.description: Neither side seems interested in a return to all-out conflict, despite the latest exchange of strikes.

item.title: Iran says it targeted American base after fresh US strikes
item.description: The hostilities come during a fragile ceasefire between the US and Iran, and protracted negotiations to end the three-month war.

item.title: Israel hits Lebanese capital in 'targeted strike'
item.description: Beirut had until now largely been spared even as both Israel and Hezbollah accused each other of breaking last month's ceasefire.
